'''Scott Manley THE LIVING FORCE''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Scott Manley]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-21993">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/21993 THE LIVING FORCE], DeckTech (Scott "tk424" Manley, 8 March 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/21993/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/21993/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Defensive Shields ==

These cards were posted as Defensive Shields outside the 60. They do not count toward the 60.

* 1x {{CardLink|Another Pathetic Lifeform (Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty)|Ref3-L-anotherpatheticlifeform.gif|label=Another Pathetic Lifeform}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Don't Do That Again (Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty)|Ref3-L-dontdothatagain.gif|label=Don't Do That Again}}
* 1x {{CardLink|A Close Race|Ref3-L-acloserace.gif}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Only Jedi Carry That Weapon|Ref3-L-onlyjedicarrythatweapon.gif}}

The post says 'SHIELDS; (any)' and names four; dested outside the 60.

The post also lists 1x whooo., which matches no known card; it is shown as posted and counted in the published total.

== Original post ==

'''THE LIVING FORCE'''
* '''Author:''' Scott "tk424" Manley
* '''Published:''' March 8, 2002
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Jedi battles,naboo fighters and pod-racing.

=== Strategy ===

I am still new on the EP1 Closed Enviornment Tournaments. (I have ran more than I have played in.)So any advice will be helpful.

This is mainly a space deck

-Deploy Systems (Use First part of Mindful of the Future)

-Use Get to your ships to deploy matching pilots to ships.(If any systems are out)

-Start deploying a group of Jedi,  then use Odin to transfer to your opponets ground forces.

-(IN THIS DECK)The power is in the numbers not in the destiny.

-Pod-race to get some force back.

This is a power-deck.

Easy for players like me.

-Scott Manley

ROGUE 66
